system.description: When you are at Death's Door, you can roll +CON or +nothing (your choice). On a 7-9, you can mark a debility of your choice to regain 1 HP.

success.value: You wrest yourself back to life — return to 1 HP; say how your brush with death has marked you.

partial.value: You're no longer dying but out of the action — or mark a debility of your choice to regain 1 HP.

failure.value: Your time has come — resolve Death's Door (a last move, refuse and gain an insert, or beseech the Things Below).
